name: furioustubes-tests
description: Tests des règles Firestore et de la couche de données (émulateurs Firebase)

scripts.rules: cd .. && npx --prefix tests firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-ft "node tests/rules.test.js"
scripts.e2e: cd .. && npx --prefix tests firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-ft "node tests/e2e.js"
